versions.content: Usage of DependencyOnArtifact The class Depen- dencyOnArtifact can be aggregated by Implementation in several different roles. By this it can also be used to specify that a certain generator tool is required to integrate a module and/or that a certain artifact is generated. For libraries, like e.g. a math.lib , the desired version numbers can be specified via the attribute revisionLabel , therefore trying to ensure compatibility. Note that the specification of version numbers and other attributes is a meta-information about cer- tain artifacts which shall refer to a concrete catalog description.
